svg.title: Lord of Swiftness: Eight of Wands · Mercury in Sagittarius · Hod (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Mercury above the painting and Sagittarius below, as Book T places them: "Surmounting the small wands with flames issuing down them, and placed in the centre at the top and bottom of the card respectively, are the symbols of Mercury and Sagittarius for the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1793138397263-o5altmksjw.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
